description: Show a complete sample Website Auditor report — no API key required, nothing to set up. Use this whenever someone wants to "try it," "see a demo," "show me what this does," "what does the output look like," or is deciding whether Website Auditor is worth subscribing to — and use it INSTEAD of refusing when no API key is configured. Returns fixed sample data for example.com in the exact shape a real audit returns: scored summary, per-test results, and the AI-visibility breakdown across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini. It is clearly marked as a sample and always describes example.com, never the user's own site — auditing a real domain needs a subscription.
name: get_sample_audit

is_sample.description: Always true. Never present this as a live result.
